# KartUI components

Use `ui/views/` for root screens selected by game code, `ui/components/` for
reusable typed children, and `ui/layouts/` for build-time page shells. Those
directories are conventions; all `.ui` assets/layouts must be declared in
`karty.toml`. `game.ui` is one active root. Calling a component mounts a child;
it never replaces the root.

## File form

One `.ui` file may contain Go imports/types, one optional setup block, exactly
one `kartui Name` component, and one optional `style` block:

```go
type InventoryProps struct { Count func() int; Close func() }

setup Inventory(props InventoryProps) {
    selected := uint32(0)
    choose := func(id uint32) { selected = id; invalidate() }
}

kartui Inventory {
    <panel modal="true" onBack={ props.Close } class="screen">
        <label class="title">Inventory</label>
        <button enabled={ props.Count() > 0 } onClick={ props.Close }>Close</button>
    </panel>
}
```

`setup Name(props Type)` runs once per mounted instance. Its locals/closures
are instance-local. Call `invalidate()` after changing UI-local state; the host
does not need a complete view every game frame. Props are available to setup,
and retained children receive fresh props when their parent invalidates.

## Markup

| Element | Attributes | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panel` | `class`; root: `modal="true"`, `onBack={ func() }` | Root must be a panel; nested panels create layout parents. |
| `label` | `class` | Static text is its body. |
| `image` | `class` | Style `image` chooses a typed theme image. |
| `button` | `class`, `enabled={ bool }`, `onClick={ func() }` | Leaf control. |
| `list` | `class`, `rows={ []UIRow }`, `onClick={ func(uint32) }` | Host-owned rows. |
| `ComponentName` | `props={ TypedValue }`; in a loop `key={ stringOrUint32 }` | Must be an exported project component. |
| `fragment` | `slot="name"` | Only while invoking a layout. |
| `slot` | optional `name="name"` | Only inside a `layout` declaration. |

Dynamic attributes use Go expressions in `{ ... }`. `class` is one CSS
identifier, not a list. Panels cannot be controls; labels do not click; controls
are leaves. Unknown attributes fail compilation.

## Composition, loops, and conditions

Children take one typed props argument:

```html
<ItemRow props={ ItemRowProps{ ID: id, Use: props.Use } } />
```

Only child components may occur in a range, which requires a stable `string`
(max 128 UTF-8 bytes) or `uint32` key. Keys preserve setup state on reordering;
array positions are not identity.

```go
for _, item := range props.Items() {
    <ItemRow key={ item.ID } props={ ItemRowProps{Item: item} } />
}
```

`if condition { ... } else { ... }` conditionally projects ordinary markup.
Use a child component instead of nested range loops. Cycles, duplicate keys,
duplicate slot fills, recursive layouts, and unsupported markup fail. Limits per
root: 256 instances, depth 16, 1,024 elements, 4,096 list rows.
Other syntax is not supported by SDK 0.11.

## Layouts and navigation

`layout Name { <panel>...</panel> }` has one root panel, slots, and styles but
no Go setup/runtime asset name. Direct children fill `<slot/>`; named
`<fragment slot="...">` fills named slots. `onBack={ fn }` is the only layout
invocation attribute and assigns its semantic Back callback. Escape and gamepad
East/Back activate it. Modal roots consume game input; non-modal roots cannot
contain interactive descendants. Touch/focus/scroll are host behavior; callbacks
are the client-visible action boundary.
